patients.summary: Healthy elementary school teacher who joined in 2023. Hyperemesis gravidarum with two ED visits in her first pregnancy (2025), last seen at 30 weeks; a term delivery, then a second pregnancy with a right ureteral stone that passed (2026), known to the practice only through records and messages.

documents.title: New patient call
documents.author: front desk
documents.body: Caller would like to establish primary care with us. Teacher, says she has summers off so wants to get in before classes resume. Last physical was a little over a year ago at her old office. Insurance is a PPO through her school district employer. Booked new patient physical 8/22 8:00 AM. Records release form emailed, she'll sign and send back to us.

documents.title: New Patient Preventive Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
25 y/o F, new to the practice, transferring care from her prior primary care office. Teaches elementary school. No complaints today, just wants a doctor she can reach.

PMH: none. No chronic illness, no hospitalizations.
PSH: tonsils out as a child (around age 8); wisdom teeth pulled at 20.
Meds: none. No supplements.
Allergies: no known drug allergies.
FHx: mother was hospitalized for severe vomiting in pregnancy (hyperemesis). A maternal uncle keeps getting kidney stones, calcium oxalate per family. Paternal grandmother has type 2 diabetes.
SHx: married. Never smoked. Does not drink at all. Elementary school teacher.
GYN: regular cycles. Last Pap at prior office in 2022, normal per patient; requested records.

ROS negative across systems.

Exam: well appearing, pleasant. HEENT normal, tonsils surgically absent. Neck supple, no thyroid enlargement. Heart regular, no murmur. Lungs clear. Abdomen soft, nontender. Skin clear. Neuro grossly intact. Mood bright.
PHQ-2 0.

A/P: healthy adult, establishing care.
- Screening: CBC, lipids today (never had a lipid panel), one-time HIV and hep C screens; she agrees.
- Pap: due 2025, will confirm from records.
- Vaccines: will review prior records for Tdap and COVID; flu shot in October at a nurse visit.
- Return next year for a physical, or message any time.

documents.title: Your lab results
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Hi Leah, everything from Tuesday came back fine. Blood counts normal, cholesterol in a healthy range, and the HIV and hepatitis C screens were negative. Nothing to do. Nice to meet you.

documents.title: RE: Your lab results
documents.author: patient
documents.body: Great, thank you! I sent the records form to my old office yesterday.

documents.title: Annual Physical
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
26F here for yearly physical, came straight from her classroom. Feels well. No new problems this year.

They are hoping to try for a pregnancy over the next few months and she wanted to talk about what to do beforehand. Cycles regular. No meds. Never smoked, no alcohol.

We talked through preconception basics: start a prenatal vitamin with iron now so the folate is on board ahead of conception; she is immune to measles and chickenpox by vaccine history (2 doses each documented); flu and COVID shots are reasonable and safe either way. I mentioned her mother's hyperemesis history: worth telling her OB early, since it can run in families. She laughed and said her mom brings it up every holiday.

Exam: normal. Wt 61.6. Heart and lungs normal, abdomen benign, thyroid not enlarged.
PHQ-2 0.

A/P
1. Preventive care: up to date. Labs from last year were normal, nothing needed today. Pap due next year (2022 normal); OB can do it if she is pregnant by then.
2. Preconception: prenatal vitamin with iron, 1 daily, sent to pharmacy. Message me with a positive test and we'll get her to OB.
3. Flu and 2024-25 COVID given today.
RTC 1 year.
